entries.title: Hebrews 12:1
segments: Therefore since we also are surrounded with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily besets [us], and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

entries.title: Hebrews 12:2
segments: looking to Jesus the Author and Finisher of [our] faith, who for the joy that was set before Him endured [the] cross, despising the shame, and sat down at the right of the throne of God.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:3
segments: For consider Him who endured such contradiction of sinners against Himself, lest you be weary and faint in your minds.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:4
segments: You have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:5
segments: And you have forgotten the exhortation which speaks to you as to children, "My son, despise not the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are rebuked by Him;

entries.title: Hebrews 12:6
segments: for whom the Lord loves He chastens, and He scourges every son whom He receives."

entries.title: Hebrews 12:7
segments: If you endure chastening, God deals with you as with sons, for what son is he whom the father does not chasten?

entries.title: Hebrews 12:8
segments: But if you are without chastisement, of which all are partakers, then you are bastards and not sons.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:9
segments: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh who corrected [us], and we gave [them] reverence. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits and live?

entries.title: Hebrews 12:10
segments: For truly they chastened [us] for a few days according to their own pleasure, but He for our profit, that [we] might be partakers of His holiness.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:11
segments: Now chastening for the present does not seem to be joyous, but grievous. Nevertheless afterward it yields the peaceable fruit of righteousness to those who are exercised by it.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:12
segments: Because of this, straighten up the hands which hang down and the enfeebled knees.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:13
segments: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way, but let it rather be healed.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:14
segments: Follow peace with all, and holiness, without which no one shall see the Lord;

entries.title: Hebrews 12:15
segments: looking diligently lest any fail of the grace of God, or lest any root of bitterness springing up disturb [you], and by it many are defiled,

entries.title: Hebrews 12:16
segments: (lest there [be] any fornicator, or profane person like Esau, who for one morsel of food sold his birthright.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:17
segments: For you know that afterward, when he desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected; for he did not find any place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears).

entries.title: Hebrews 12:18
segments: For you have not come to the mountain that might be touched and that burned with fire, nor to blackness and darkness and tempest,

entries.title: Hebrews 12:19
segments: and the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words (which [voice] they who heard begged that the word should not be spoken to them any more,

entries.title: Hebrews 12:20
segments: for they could not endure the thing commanded, "And if so much as a beast should touch the mountain, it shall be stoned or thrust through with a dart,"

entries.title: Hebrews 12:21
segments: and so fearful was the sight [that] Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake).

entries.title: Hebrews 12:22
segments: But you have come to Mount Zion and to [the] city of [the] living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,

entries.title: Hebrews 12:23
segments: to the [general] assembly and church of the first-born who are written in Heaven, and to God [the] judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,

entries.title: Hebrews 12:24
segments: and to Jesus the Mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better things than [that of] Abel.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:25
segments: See [that] you do not refuse Him who speaks. For if they did not escape, those who refused him that spoke on earth, much more we [shall not escape] if we turn away from Him who speaks from Heaven,

entries.title: Hebrews 12:26
segments: whose voice then shook the earth; but now He has promised, saying, "Yet once more I will not only shake the earth, but also the heavens."

entries.title: Hebrews 12:27
segments: And this [word], "Yet once more," signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, so that the things which cannot be shaken may remain.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:28
segments: Therefore, since we are receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, let us have grace, by which we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear,

entries.title: Hebrews 12:29
segments: for also, "Our God [is] a consuming fire."
